categories.main_business_segments: Jiangmen Kanhoo Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: new energy cathode materials, new energy intelligent equipment, and rare earth functional materials. The cathode materials include ternary, lithium cobalt oxide, lithium manganese oxide, and lithium iron phosphate materials used in power batteries, consumer electronics, and energy storage. The intelligent equipment segment focuses on manufacturing key lithium-ion battery production equipment such as coating machines, rolling machines, and slitting machines. The rare earth materials segment produces luminescent and oxygen storage materials for lighting and environmental applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in high-precision extrusion coating, intelligent production line integration, and innovative equipment design, including dry coating technology for solid-state batteries. It has developed high-voltage, high-capacity lithium cobalt oxide materials, high-nickel ternary materials, and manganese iron phosphate cathode materials. The intelligent equipment segment features patented technologies in coating, rolling, and slitting with precise control over thickness and speed. The company also invests in R&D for sodium-ion battery cathode materials, cobalt-free cathodes, and solid-state battery materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include battery manufacturers in the electric vehicle, consumer electronics (3C products, drones, smart wearables), energy storage, and industrial sectors. The company serves major battery producers such as BYD, Sunwoda, and Envision Power. Its products are used in electric vehicles, electric tools, mobile power supplies, electronic cigarettes, and lighting applications. The rare earth materials serve lighting manufacturers and environmental catalyst producers. The company has a strong presence in both domestic Chinese markets and some international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D facilities in Guangdong (Jiangmen, Zhuhai), Shenzhen, and other provinces including Jiangsu and Zhejiang. It also has overseas sales but the majority of revenue is generated domestically. The company’s products are sold across various regions in China including Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Fujian, and some export markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangmen Kanhoo Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on the production of cathode materials and manufacturing equipment essential for battery cell production. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream equipment manufacturing and customer service, forming a vertically coordinated business model with strong links to battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D driven innovation focusing on high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide, ultra-high nickel ternary cathode materials, sodium-ion batteries, solid-state batteries, and advanced intelligent coating and rolling equipment. It pursues a dual-drive strategy integrating cathode materials and intelligent equipment development, collaborating with top universities and research institutes. The company plans to establish dedicated research institutes for new energy materials and intelligent equipment and aims to enhance digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of new energy cathode materials, intelligent manufacturing equipment, and rare earth functional materials. The company uses a direct sales model with pricing based on raw material costs plus manufacturing fees. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and occasional consulting and disposal of scrap materials. The intelligent equipment segment operates on customized order-driven sales with long-term strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a significant player in the Chinese new energy cathode materials and intelligent equipment market, ranking among the top five in lithium cobalt oxide and top eight in lithium manganese oxide shipments nationally. It competes with leading battery material and equipment manufacturers by leveraging its dual business model and strong R&D capabilities. The company maintains competitive advantages through vertical integration, technology innovation, and close customer collaboration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.12 billion, a decline of nearly 30% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 192 million, showing a reduced loss compared to the previous year. The company’s revenue is split roughly 59% from materials and 41% from equipment. It has a workforce of over 1,200 employees, with a dedicated R&D team of about 249 people. Despite recent financial challenges, the company is actively restructuring and optimizing operations to improve profitability and cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'new energy cathode materials + intelligent equipment' dual-drive business model, offering comprehensive solutions from materials to manufacturing equipment. It emphasizes high-quality, high-yield products with advanced technology such as dry coating and high-precision equipment, reducing operational costs and improving efficiency. Strong R&D collaboration with academic institutions and a robust patent portfolio underpin its innovation leadership. The company also focuses on customer customization and technical support to enhance client loyalty and market competitiveness.
